model.name: Generate requirements.md from Requirement units (close the law #100 hand-drift gap)
model.description: requirements.md becomes a GENERATED view emitted from the sprint's Requirement units (like planning.md + task MDs already are), with a --check byte-match round-trip - so requirements.md can never hand-drift from the units. Today requirements.md is HAND-MAINTAINED (generate-sprint-md only emits planning.md + task MDs); its 'GENERATED-FROM-SCENARIO-UNITS / DO-NOT-HAND-EDIT' header is aspirational. This closes the law #100 gap by construction: the Requirement unit is the single source, the .md is derived.
model.tronQuote: > PO 2026-07-02: requirements.md is hand-maintained (no generator) - the law #100 gap. Make it GENERATED from Requirement units + --check byte-match, so no hand-drift.

discoverySource.flaggedBy: robbin-po (+ planner measured no generator exists)

model.crossRefNote: Sibling to generate-sprint-md (R27.3 emits planning.md + task MDs). R28.1 extends the generator to requirements.md. Same --check byte-match discipline. Closes law #100 by construction (like R27.2 reuse-on-wire / R27.5 self-honest-marker: make the invariant structural, not a header).

acceptanceCriteria.text: requirements.md is GENERATED (emitted) from the sprint's Requirement units - altId, name, requirement:uuid, tronQuote, description, acceptanceCriteria, UC arrow - matching the current format, like planning.md is generated.
generate-requirements-md --check does a byte-match round-trip (like generate-sprint-md --check / check:sprint-md); any hand-drift between requirements.md and the units FAILS CI.
After this, requirements.md is NEVER hand-edited; the Requirement unit is the single source and the .md is derived (the law #100 header becomes TRUE, not aspirational).
Regenerating requirements.md for any sprint from its Requirement units produces output byte-identical to the committed file; ci:gates includes the --check.
